title: My top songs for 2022
subtitle: Spotify Unwrapped
html:
It’s that time of year! My Spotify Unwrapped just came out and because I’m unable to share the playlist they made for me, I transferred the songs over to another playlist.

Here’s how you can do it yourself:

  1. Create new playlist

  2. Highlight all of the songs in your Unwrapped

  3. Drag them into your newly created playlist

  4. Share with the world!

If you’re interested in listening to my top songs for this year, check them out below. Please share yours with me if you have one.
